defs.def: a set of rooms for living in, usually on one floor of a building （通常指在同一楼层的）公寓套房

ex.s: I sit in my apartment today, loving each of the ___53___ that share our small space.
ex.t: 但现在是澄清事实的时候了，首先要质疑"所有社会比较都是不健康的"这一观点。

ex.s: Someone is planning to move out of our building, and their apartment will be _________ for rent at the beginning of March.

ex.s: Share an apartment with you.

ex.s: To look at an apartment.
ex.t: 去看一套公寓。

ex.s: Fire extinguishers are located on each floor and in each apartment． Use a fire extinguisher only if you have been trained to do so． Irresponsible use of a fire extinguisher can create a dangerous situation for other residents and could result in damage to personal property． Misuse of a fire extinguisher will result in fines．
ex.t: 每层楼和每个公寓都配有灭火器。只有在受过训练时才可使用。不负责任地使用灭火器会给其他住户带来危险，并可能损坏个人财产。滥用灭火器将被罚款。

ex.s: I assumed I’d already have a well-paid job and that I’d be moving into a rented apartment as soon as I turned 18, but how wrong I was!
ex.t: 我以为我已经有了一份高薪工作，我18岁就要搬进租来的公寓了，但我错了！

ex.s: I know I could get a bank loan to pay the deposit on my very own apartment, but I don’t feel ready to make that kind of commitment, and I do like my mom’s cooking.
ex.t: 我知道我可以获得银行贷款来支付我自己公寓的押金，但我还没有准备好做出这样的承诺，我确实喜欢我妈妈的烹饪。

ex.s: He lived in a small apartment with a shared washroom.
ex.t: 他住在一间带共用洗手间的小公寓里。

ex.s: The surface of the apartment building is covered in panels that contain algae.
ex.t: 公寓楼的表面覆盖着含有藻类的面板。

ex.s: First, apologise to your teammate.
ex.t: 首先，向队友道歉。

ex.s: Agony Aunt 1 Ben said something bad about his best friend, and Agony Aunt told him to apologise to his friend.
ex.t: 痛苦阿姨1本对他最好的朋友说了些坏话，痛苦阿姨让他向他的朋友道歉。

ex.s: Tips for happy and healthy relationships 1 Try to forgive someone when they apologise.
ex.t: 幸福和健康关系的建议1当某人道歉时，试着原谅他。

ex.s: H: Oh, my dearest dear sir, I apologise for what I said.
ex.t: H ：哦，我最亲爱的先生，我为我说的话道歉。

defs.def: a set of rooms used for a holiday/vacation （度假用的）公寓套房
a room in a house, especially a large or famous house （尤指巨屋、名宅的）房间

ex.s: A housewarming party is a special party to be held when someone buys or moves into a new apartment or house.
ex.t: 暖房派对是当有人购买或搬进新公寓或新房时举办的特殊派对。

ex.s: Ellie 24 Junior doctor (1 picture) There’s not enough room to swing a cat in my small apartment, so I don’t cook very often.
ex.t: Ellie 24初级医生（ 1张照片）我的小公寓没有足够的空间荡猫，所以我不经常做饭。
